details: is an American transcription software company based in Mountain View, California. The company develops speech to text transcription applications using artificial intelligence and machine learning. Its software, called Otter, shows captions for live speakers, and generates written transcriptions of speech. While Otter's software has been praised for its functionality, it is also the subject of privacy concerns, including allegations that the company records users' conversations without consent.

explainer.lead: Otter.ai is a transcription software company whose AI product generates written transcripts and live captions from speech. Its privacy record has drawn scrutiny, including allegations of recording conversations without consent.

tiers.eli5: It's an app that listens to a meeting and types out what everyone said, like a fast note-taker sitting in the room.
tiers.practitioner: Teams use it to capture meetings and search transcripts later. The pitfall is consent and data handling: recordings and transcripts may capture sensitive conversation, so deployment needs clear notice and policy.
tiers.paperLevel: No formal definition applies; it is a commercial speech-to-text application built on machine learning.

explainer.example: A remote team runs Otter in a standup; it shows live captions and afterwards produces a searchable transcript of who said what.
